newsitem.title: USA: CHS Electronics completes stock offering.
newsitem.headline: CHS Electronics completes stock offering.

text.p: CHS Electronics Inc said on Friday it has completed a public offering of 13 million shares of common stock at a price of $31.75 per share.

Claudio Osorio, chairman and chief executive officer of CHS, said in a statement that the company originally planned to issue 10 million shares, and that the final price has increased since the offering was first proposed in June.
The total value of the offering was $412.8 million -- approximately $150 million more than expected originally, the company said.
Osorio said CHS expects to net approximately $394 million, exclusive of additional amounts which will become available if the underwriters elect to exercise their overallotment option.

As previously announced, $74 million of the proceeds are to be used to provide the cash portion of CHS's acquisition of Karma International SA, a Switzerland-based personal computer component distributor.
The balance of the proceeds will be used for future acquisitions and to increase CHS's working capital.
Underwriters of the offering were Raymond James & Associates Inc, Montgomery Securities, J.C. Bradford & Company, and Cleary Gull Reiland & McDevitt Inc.
